name: codecompass
description: Local-first static Java architecture cockpit: index a repo and get an AST-driven dashboard, call chains, tours and PR impact analysis.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix packages/contracts && npm install --prefix packages/bridge-adapters && npm install --prefix services/control-plane && npm install --prefix apps/repoqa-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix packages/contracts && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/bridge-adapters && npm run typecheck --prefix services/control-plane && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/repoqa-web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/contracts && npm run build --prefix packages/bridge-adapters && npm run build --prefix services/control-plane && npm run build --prefix apps/repoqa-web
